about.title: About Antigravity-i18n-Pro
about.desc: A single-file tool that localizes the Antigravity desktop interface, with a focus on Traditional Chinese for Taiwan. Pure Go, no Node runtime.
about.f1.title: Your own languages:
about.f1.body: export a template, translate it and apply it as a language file; it is checked before anything is written.
about.f2.title: Byte-exact restore:
about.f2.body: a clean app.asar is kept before the first patch, and restoring brings back the official file byte for byte.
about.f3.title: Verified and rolled back:
about.f3.body: offsets and integrity are recalculated, and any failing step puts everything back.
about.disclaimer: A community-maintained, unofficial tool, not affiliated with Antigravity.
